Maya: Heads up — replay harness results diverging from synthetic loadtests. p50 up ~12% on latest kernel selection change (PR #4821). Anyone else see this?
Aaron: Yep. Saw same on g4dn. Synthetic shows 8ms p50, replay 11ms. Looks like kernel choice flips when batch sizes vary.
Li: Quick note: kernel auto-selector picks different matmul kernels depending on seq len distribution. Replay traces have longer prefixes so fused-attention path not used.
Maya: Is that due to KV cache warm/cold behavior? Replay has warm KV but different prefix reuse patterns.
Li: Exactly. When prefix reuse >70% we hit cached KV path, smaller matmul shapes. When reuse drops, batching packs more new tokens -> different kernels.
Sophia: We should do apples-to-apples: same trace + synthetic derived trace with identical seqlen and user inter-arrival. I wrote a small transformer to replay sampled seqlen histogram.
Sophia: ```
# reproduce
python tools/replay.py \  --trace traces/session-2025-11-08.json \  --gpu 0 \  --batching=work-conserving \  --kernel-policy=auto \  --quant-profile=int8-fast
```
Aaron: also add `--force-kernel=matmul-fused` to test kernel path parity. And run with nsys sampling.
Li: ```
nsys profile --sample=cpu --trace=nvtx -o out ./bin/infer --model path/to.ckpt
# top kernels:
# 1. fused_attention 42ms
# 2. matmul_optimized 28ms
# 3. kv_cache_copy 5ms
```
PerfBot: regression-detect: p50 increased 18% vs baseline after merge a1b2c3. Alerting perf-ci. Tags: kernel-selection, kv-cache
Maya: Proposed plan: (1) run apples-to-apples for three seeds (2) toggle quantization profiles (fp16,int8) (3) run speculative decoding on/off (4) collect flamegraphs + nvprof.
Sophia: Agree. Also add regression gate: block merge if p50 > baseline*1.10 on dedicated benchmarks within CI for dedicated branch. I can add script to perf-ci.
Aaron: One more gotcha: quantization sometimes changes kernel codepath because int8 path uses different matmul kernels -> can mask batching gains. Need baseline with quantization disabled.
Li: I'll instrument KV cache hit distribution and emit histogram to traces: prefix_reuse_pct, avg_kv_read_ms. That should show why replay behaves differently.
Maya: Great. Can someone run a quick smoke: run replay with force-kernel + quant disabled, attach outputs here? @Aaron @Li
Aaron: On it, starting now. I'll paste logs in 10m.
